latest_release.name: v0.8.0
latest_release.body:
Kan's backend has moved to a dedicated NestJS API. For self-hosters, nothing about running Kan changes.

## Upgrading

Pull and restart as usual, no compose or `.env` changes needed. The `kan` image now runs the web app and API together; to run them separately, see [Separate containers](https://docs.kan.bn/self-hosting/introduction#separate-containers).

Running from source now needs Node 24.

### Check if these apply to you

- **AWS S3 (#590):** with a blank `S3_ENDPOINT`, set `NEXT_PUBLIC_STORAGE_URL` or attachment downloads return 403.
- **OIDC (#728):** update your provider's redirect URI to `<NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/api/auth/callback/oidc`.
- **Behind a proxy (#719):** set `RATE_LIMIT_IP_HEADER` (e.g. `cf-connecting-ip`, `x-real-ip`) so rate limits use the real client IP.

## Highlights

- Forgot and reset password (#612)
- Faster board loading (#572)
- Better MCP tool descriptions and name/slug lookups (#714)
- Security upgrades: Next.js 16, Better Auth 1.7, Drizzle 0.45 (#728)

## API changes

- tRPC is gone; `/api/v1` is served by the new API (#710).
- Workspace by slug moved to `GET /api/v1/workspaces/slug/{slug}`.
- Errors are now `{ statusCode, message, error }`.

## What's Changed
* fix: stop publishing the Postgres port in the default compose files by @10k11 in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/666
* feat: add forgot/reset password  by @MrityunjayRoy in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/612
* perf: reduce board payload with compact card summaries by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/572
* fix: validate attachment download URLs when S3_ENDPOINT is unset by @nickmeinhold in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/590
* chore: move default Node.js runtime to 24 LTS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/673
* fix(db): fix checklist item reorder after soft-deleted item by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/670
* chore: replace Discord community links with GitHub Discussions by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/674
* fix(db): make stuck-instance migrations idempotent so upgrades self-heal by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/675
* fix(db): honor libpq sslmode semantics for encrypted Postgres connections by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/676
* chore: remove umami analytics by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/677
* fix: don't let a card.byId refetch stomp an in-progress title/description edit by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/684
* fix: keep the avatar crop dialog within the screen by @lord-0011 in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/681
* fix: add marketing site SEO metadata by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/685
* feat(api): scaffold NestJS api service, port feedback router by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/686
* fix(auth): support cross-subdomain cookies for separately deployed apps/api by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/687
* fix(cloud): pin api service port by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/688
* fix(api): use dedicated API_PORT env var by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/689
* feat(api): port MCP server into apps/api, starting with feedback by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/690
* feat(api): port list router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/692
* fix(docker): shrink the api image with its own scoped prod install by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/693
* feat(api): port label router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/695
* feat(api): port boardMember router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/696
* feat(api): port checklist router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/698
* feat(api): port member router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/699
* feat(api): port permission router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/700
* feat(api): port workspace router to NestJS by @ovran in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/701
* fix(api): strip u

![github-background](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f728f52e-bf67-4357-9ba2-c24c437488e3)

Kan

The open-source project management alternative to Trello.

Roadmap · Website · Docs · Discussions

## Features - **Board Visibility**: Control who can view and edit your boards - **Workspace Members**: Invite members and collaborate with your team - **Trello Imports**: Easily import your Trello boards - **Labels & Filters**: Organise and find cards quickly - **Comments**: Discuss and collaborate with your team - **Activity Log**: Track all card changes with detailed activity history - **Templates**: Save time with reusable custom board templates - **Integrations (coming soon)**: Connect your favourite tools See our [roadmap](https://kan.bn/kan/roadmap) for upcoming features. ## Screenshot ## Made With - [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/?ref=kan.bn) - [NestJS](https://nestjs.com/?ref=kan.bn) - [Better Auth](https://better-auth.com/?ref=kan.bn) - [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/?ref=kan.bn) - [Drizzle ORM](https://orm.drizzle.team/?ref=kan.bn) - [React Email](https://react.email/?ref=kan.bn) ## Self Hosting ### One-click Deployments The easiest way to deploy Kan is through Railway. We've partnered with Railway to maintain an official template that supports the development of the project. ### Docker Compose Alternatively, you can self-host Kan with Docker Compose. This will set up everything for you including your postgres database and automatically run migrations. 1. Create a `.env` file with your environment variables (see [Environment Variables](#environment-variables) section below) 2. Use the [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) file provided in the repository, which sets up Postgres, runs migrations, and starts the web service 3. Start the containers in detached mode: ```bash docker compose up -d ``` The application will be available at http://localhost:3000 (or the port specified in `WEB_PORT`). **Managing containers:** - To stop the containers: `docker compose down` - To view logs: `docker compose logs -f` - To restart the containers: `docker compose restart` - To rebuild after code changes: `docker compose up -d --build` To run the web app and API as separate containers, see [Separate containers](https://docs.kan.bn/self-hosting/introduction#separate-containers). ## Local Development 1. Clone the repository (or fork) ```bash git clone https://github.com/kanbn/kan.git ``` 2. Install dependencies ```bash pnpm install ``` 3. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and configure your environment variables 4. Migrate database ```bash pnpm db:migrate ``` 5. Start the development server ```bash pnpm dev ``` ## Environment Variables At minimum, you'll need: | Variable | Description | Example | | ----------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | | `POSTGRES_URL` | PostgreSQL connection URL | `postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/db` | | `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | Base URL of your installation | `http://localhost:3000` | | `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` | Auth encryption secret | Random 32+ char string | Optional integrations (email/SMTP, OAuth and OIDC login, S3-compatible file storage, Trello import, rate limiting, white labelling, and more) are configured through additional variables. See [.env.example](./.env.example) for the complete list. ## MCP Server Kan ships with a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) (MCP) server that lets any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others) read and control your Kan instance using natural language. Run it with `npx`, no clone or global install required: ```bash npx -y @kan.bn/mcp ``` Configure it with two environment variables: `KAN_BASE_URL` (your Kan instance) and `KAN_API_TOKEN` (from **Settings → API Keys**). Then point your client's MCP config at the `npx -y @kan.bn/mcp` command. See the [MCP Server docs](https://docs.kan.bn/mcp) for per-client config (Claude Desktop, Codex, and others), example prompts, the full tool reference, and troubleshooting. ## Contributing We welcome contributions! Please read our [contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting a pull request. ## Contributors ## Sponsors [](https://www.testmuai.com) Proudly sponsored by [TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest)](https://www.testmuai.com) - an AI-native testing cloud platform built for modern engineering teams. Covering everything from autonomous test creation and fast execution to testing AI agents like chatbots and voice assistants. If you're serious about testing, go check them out. ## License Kan is licensed under the [AGPLv3 license](LICENSE). ## Contact For support or to get in touch, please email [henry@kan.bn](mailto:henry@kan.bn) or start a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/kanbn/kan/discussions).
